candidateBlocks.rationale: The complete contiguous six-row high-pressure tail is entirely within the reported +/-1 m/s accuracy, with sub-1 m/s MAE and RMS. The immediately adjacent 21.39 MPa row errs by +1.896119 m/s and defines the conservative lower boundary.
